title: Pancreatic beta cell cytokine-induced survival CRISPR screen (Benaglio et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Type 1 diabetes risk genes mediate pancreatic beta cell survival in response to proinflammatory cytokines.
Benaglio P et al.
Cell Genom. 2022 Nov 11;2(12):100214. doi: 10.1016/j.xgen.2022.100214.
PMID: 36778047

In this study, a genome-wide pooled CRISPR loss-of-function screen was performed in the human pancreatic EndoC-βH1 cell line and cells were tested for survival under high-dose cytokine exposure for 72 hours. The table displays genes that had significant (FDR <0.10) differences in recovered sgRNAs between cytokine-treated and untreated cells.

View complete results from this study in the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
